verdicts.reason: In A, the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk until the sun is a dot and the wordmark can't be read, so the brand is effectively lost, and a gap of dead space separates it from the headline. B keeps the logo at a readable size, but it is jammed against the 'C' of the headline with no gutter. Both share the same CTA problems: 'Shop the Summer Line' wraps onto two lines, is almost as big as the headline so it competes with it, and a bokeh dot sits on top of 'Line'.
